protocol.question: Can a wide isolated SHORT equity budget preserve relative hedges and improve tail economics without destroying decline-stage SHORT gains?
protocol.hypothesis: Verified XRP half-collateral witness had37h lead time and original1min/prior-volume full-close capacity. A fixed rare loss-budget exit may avoid collateral exhaustion with less continuous hedge removal than absolute-direction gates.
protocol.data_role: ALL_SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; five existing source-defined stages, independent full10k wallets; neither newOOS nor investment qualification

recipe.only_change: Only held SHORT: observed post-mark/funding isolated equity<=.5current collateral triggers persistent paid reduce-only full close. No LONG stop/filter; original targets and all fees/funding/caps unchanged.
recipe.clock: Completed minute mark T; original ExecutionContract earliest T+60s+1us trade open, previous completed minute quote*.001/open capacity. Mark/funding liquidation occurs first; no retroactive rescue.
recipe.reentry: At a daily decision the original frozen expert target is nonnegative AND actual position is flat. No latch: if not flat at that nonshort decision and next decision is SHORT, stay blocked. Terminal paid-flat override is preserved.
recipe.choice_rationale: 50% is a single wide collateral loss-budget choice informed by the already-seen forensic witness, not an optimized alpha threshold. No.25/.1 or ATR/exit/cooldown scan.
recipe.risk_dependency: Hard nominal reduction retains original priority/bounded-halt. Protective loss exit changes gross/net/covariance exposure; original external10%cov targets are unchanged and actual post-stop weights can depart. Report actual vol/DD and do not claim matched-risk alpha or guaranteed safety.

default_golden.scope: 35minute2asset synthetic targets/trades/funding/minuteNAV/rejections/breaches, actual old implementation before changes; new default and no-trigger protection must match. No claim all historical accounts rerun.

thresholds.no_liquidation: all10newcases0; gaps remain capable of defeat
thresholds.all_vol_at_most12pct: all realized annualized dailyvol<=.12, descriptive on short stages
thresholds.any_material_net_or_DD_improvement: at least one netdelta>=10USDT OR MDDdelta<=-.001
thresholds.both2025_stages_SHORT_positive: SHORTnet>0 in each2025H1/H2 each conditional unit

protocol.stopping: Only this recipe. Any failed economic gate pauses exact recipe; do not tune threshold after results. Source/account/clock failure preserves attempt, correctness repair only. No locked consumption.
